title: Automating crash diagram generation using vision-language models: a case study on multilane roundabouts

live_model.evidence: Sec. 3.3: 'The experiments were conducted using the following model versions: GPT-4o (API version: gpt-4o-2024-05-13), Gemini-1.5-Flash, and Janus-4o.'

prompt.location: Sec. 3 'Prompt Design' describes the three-part structured prompt (narrative + base roundabout layout + report image); wording not printed in full

claim.metric: mean rubric score (0-10) over crash diagrams
claim.location: Sec. 5 table of ten binary metrics per model (GPT-4o highest; values not tied to a single printed total)

data.source: 79 MV-104A police crash reports (roundabout crashes) with officer sketches; not released

notes: Diagrams are scored 0/1 on ten criteria by trained human experts; outputs are images.
